requirements: Add a process-local metadata cache for report downloads and support replacing the repository when the database connection rotates. Multiple tenants can share report IDs; database adapters enforce tenant ownership when queried. Existing exports and refreshed metadata must remain available. The export storage root is the only permitted download location. Repository policy requires function docstrings. All implementation and callers are included.
comparison: complete base-to-candidate diff; all text files mode 100644

commits.subject: Cache report metadata across downloads and support repository rotation
